name: authored-c-001-retry
prompt:
Edit this four-cell exercise sheet. Preserve TOP RIGHT kettlebell-row scene exactly, because correct. TOP LEFT frog stand must have BOTH ELBOWS clearly BENT about80-100degrees, so shoulder upper arms slope forward/down to elbow and forearms slope backward/down to planted palms. Body lowers accordingly, both knees remain resting on corresponding upper arms near elbows and both feet still hover low. Ensure exactly two natural arms, all hands and knees clearly supported. BOTTOM LEFT: shrink ENTIRE band hamstring curl scene approximately75% and reconstruct COMPLETE FINITE support post TOP inside bottom-left cell with40px white gap above. Both knees close, thigh vertical, heel backward to buttock, facing low band anchor, two hands hold post crossbar. BOTTOM RIGHT: shrink ENTIRE close-grip seated cable-row scene approximately75% to show COMPLETE station upright tops and horizontal top cap inside bottom-right cell with40px white gap above, base beneath. Keep both soles on footplates, upright torso, close neutral handle to upper abdomen, cable to low pulley. All original1536x1024 two-column/two-row format, white gray lime, no labels. Exact underlying requirements:
Create ORIGINAL FORMA fitness manual illustration atlas, landscape EXACT1536x1024, TWO COLUMNS TWO ROWS FOUR LARGE768x512independentcells. Clean whitebackgrounds, subtle shadows, precise detailed charcoalgray clothing and equipment with tiny limegreen accents. Exactly ONE fully clothed adult athlete per cell, exactly TWOarms TWOlegs. NO labels, words, letters, numbers, logos, borders, watermarks or arrows. Entire bodies, supporting hands, feet, and COMPLETE apparatus fit own cell with30px blankmargin around. Do not crop any machine top or body at cell edge. Match exact support, incline angle, grip and equipment. One representative clear pose per cell.

ROW1 COLUMN1: Frog stand balance. POSITIVE POSE: FROG STAND balance, front-side three-quarter view. Fully clothed adult crouches low over mat, BOTH palms planted flat shoulderwidth fingers spread, BOTH ELBOWS noticeably BENT about90degrees. Inside of RIGHT KNEE visibly rests atop RIGHT UPPER ARM just above right elbow, inside LEFT KNEE atop LEFT UPPER ARM just above left elbow. BOTH knees very bent and splayed out, feet tucked behind pelvis and HOVER only5cm above mat, toes pointing down, both feet visibly clear of floor. Body held LOW close to floor, head looks slightly ahead of hands. Exactly2arms2legs, show every supporting hand and both knee-on-arm contacts. NO straight-arm handstand, no knees floating unsupported. FULL GUIDE: Squat on a mat and place both palms on the floor about shoulder width apart, fingers spread. Bend your elbows and rest the inside of each knee against the corresponding upper arm near the elbow. Keep your knees bent and look slightly ahead of your hands. Shift your weight forward gradually until one foot becomes light, then lift it a small distance. If stable, lift the other foot so both feet hover while your palms support you and your knees remain on your arms. Hold briefly with control, then place both feet back on the mat. Keep the lift low and stop before losing balance.

ROW1 COLUMN2: Chest-supported kettlebell row. POSITIVE POSE: CHEST SUPPORTED TWO-KETTLEBELL ROW, starting extended-arm position. Adult lies FACE DOWN chest on sturdy bench set to LOW30DEGREE incline above floor, NOT steep45or60degree. Head extends beyond higher end of pad with neck aligned torso. BOTH FEET firmly planted ON FLOOR behind lower bench end, legs spread slightly for balance. TWO arms hang almost straight DOWN from shoulders, holding ONE kettlebell in EACH hand below shoulders, each bell suspended clearly above floor and clear of frame. Neutral wrists; torso chest stays in direct contact with pad. Full bench and feet visible, head faces downforward, not seated or supine. FULL GUIDE: Set a sturdy adjustable bench to a low incline of about thirty degrees. Lie face down with your chest supported on the pad, your head beyond its upper edge and both feet firmly on the floor. Hold one kettlebell in each hand below your shoulders, with enough clearance that the weights do not hit the floor or bench frame. Keep your neck aligned with your spine and your chest against the pad. Bend both elbows and draw the kettlebells toward your lower ribs without shrugging or lifting your torso. Pause briefly, then lower slowly until your arms are extended. Choose weights that allow steady movement.

ROW2 COLUMN1: Standing band hamstring curl. POSITIVE POSE: STANDING BAND HAMSTRING CURL side view. Athlete at RIGHT of scene FACES LEFT toward secure support post at LEFT. Low resistance band anchored near FLOOR to bolted fixed post, other end clipped to clearly visible ankle cuff on RIGHT ankle. LEFT foot planted flat on floor supporting weight; RIGHT THIGH stays VERTICAL beside left thigh, RIGHT KNEE bends90degrees so heel lifts BACK toward buttock to RIGHT, shin horizontal. Knees remain close together. Both hands lightly grasp chest-height crossbar of stable bolted post in front for balance, torso upright hips square. Taut band goes diagonally from left LOW anchor to elevated right cuff. Entire support, anchor, band, cuff and athlete visible. Do not extend hip backward, no cable machine. FULL GUIDE: Anchor a resistance band low to a secure fixed point and fasten the other end to your right ankle using an appropriate ankle cuff. Stand facing the anchor with light band tension and hold a stable support for balance. Keep your knees close together, hips facing forward and torso upright. Bend the right knee to bring your heel toward your buttock while keeping the right thigh nearly vertical. Stop before your hips move or your lower back arches. Slowly straighten the knee until the foot returns near the floor. Repeat with controlled tension, then switch the cuff to the other ankle.

ROW2 COLUMN2: Seated close-grip cable row. POSITIVE POSE: SEATED CLOSE-NEUTRAL-GRIP LOW CABLE ROW. Athlete sits at complete compact low-cable rowing station with BOTH FEET visibly on angled footplates, knees softly bent. Torso VERTICAL upright neutral spine, no backward lean. Holds SMALL close-grip V-shaped parallel handle in BOTH hands with PALMS facing EACH OTHER, draws handle to UPPER ABDOMEN just below ribs; elbows flex close to ribcage and shoulders down. Cable runs taut from center of handle to LOW pulley in front below knee height, full compact stack/base/seat/footplates visible inside panel. One handle with two parallel grips, not wide straight bar; thighs and seat support clear. FULL GUIDE: Sit at a low-cable rowing station with both feet on its footplates and a close neutral-grip handle attached. Keep your knees slightly bent and hold the handle with both hands. Sit tall with a neutral spine and begin with your arms extended in front of you. Draw the handle toward your upper abdomen, keeping your elbows near your sides and your shoulders away from your ears. Pause briefly as your shoulder blades move together, without leaning backward or jerking your torso. Extend your arms slowly to return the handle, keeping your feet and hips in place. Repeat with a manageable load.
